title: DECIDE: multi-episode claim export policy — primary locator vs per-episode span lists
description:
Rule-of-5 review finding EDGE-002 (TypeSafe-verified 0.89).

am_claim_fields admits lineage of >=1 episode ids but carries exactly one evidence_span and one locator. Export policy for claims grounded in several episodes is undefined and schema-shaping for sun-mqs.

Options:
(a) RECOMMENDED for v1 — one record per claim with a designated primary locator/span; lineage stays provenance (one claim, many supports).
(b) per-episode span lists (episode_id, span, locator tuples) — richer, layerable later as an optional field.

Land before sun-mqs schema freeze. This issue blocks sun-mqs.

title: DECIDE: episode-text home — descriptor-owned (recommended) vs self-contained manifest
description:
Rule-of-5 review finding CORR-002 (TypeSafe-verified 0.84).

am_strict_parse demands parse-time refusal of 'references to absent episodes', but manifest claim records carry only episode ids — episode text lives in the descriptor (ai_verbatim_text). So the check as placed is impossible without a schema change or a check relocation.

Options:
(a) RECOMMENDED — descriptor owns episode text; move the absent-episode refusal to the join stage (extend ai_descriptor_required or add a join-time invariant in anchored-ir). am_strict_parse keeps unknown-fields/duplicate-keys. Matches the sunset/bajan division; keeps manifests small.
(b) manifest carries an episodes registry (self-contained; strengthens 'rendering needs no store access'; larger manifests; audit could run manifest-only).

Land the decision as a corpus amendment (+ mirrors redeploy) BEFORE sun-mqs schema freeze. This issue blocks sun-mqs.

title: cross-repo: bajan proposal-import path for sunshine drift-report corrections
description: Rule-of-5 review finding CORR-006. ac_human_edits declares human-edited artifacts as the correction signal flowing 'to the claim store as proposals through the store's own review path' — but the transport is unowned: sunshine never writes to the store (fb_readonly_view), and bajan's corpus has no manifest-derived-proposal importer. File the upstream issue in charly-vibes/bajan so the correction loop is not orphaned; until then this issue tracks the coordination.
